note_history.10-Q.key_note_tags.from: the current 10-Q XBRL instance 10-Q/amd-20260627_htm.xml: every element whose local name ends in 'TextBlock' listed with ElementTree and a start-ns pass for the prefixes, importing nothing from src/, then each name read against the six key notes docs/INPUT_SPEC.md section 5 names — critical_accounting_estimates: us-gaap:SignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock, the note opening 'Basis of Presentation and Significant Accounting Policies' whose 'Use of Estimates' paragraph names the areas of subjective judgment ('revenue allowances, inventory valuation, valuation of goodwill and long-lived and intangible assets, business combination accounting and income taxes'), and us-gaap:OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock, the note opening 'The Company Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. is a global semiconductor company', as Carrier's reading took that tag over its description-of-the-business note beside its policies note; contingencies: us-gaap:CommitmentsContingenciesAndGuaranteesTextBlock ('Commitments and Contingencies'); debt: the note about what the company owes, us-gaap:DebtDisclosureTextBlock ('Debt, Revolving Credit Facility and Commercial Paper Program'), with us-gaap:ScheduleOfDebtTableTextBlock, the Senior Notes table inside it, and the table on the filer's own tag amd:FinancialInstrumentsNotRecordedAtFairValueOnRecurringBasisTableTextBlock, which holds nothing but debt ('The carrying amounts and estimated fair values of the Company’s current and long-term debt are as follows'), the content Ciena's, Johnson Controls' and Omnicell's readings took as debt under us-gaap:ScheduleOfCarryingValuesAndEstimatedFairValuesOfDebtInstrumentsTableTextBlock; related_parties: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentsDisclosureTextBlock, the note titled 'Equity Method Investments' and opening 'The Company has investments accounted for under the equity method, which are considered related parties', which reports the purchases from and amounts payable to those related parties, as Sandisk's reading took its Flash Ventures joint-venture note; no revenue-recognition note and no subsequent-events note is tagged in either quarter (us-gaap:SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock and us-gaap:ScheduleOfSegmentReportingInformationBySegmentTextBlock are the segment note, not the revenue recognition policy, as NetApp's and Logitech's readings took their segment tables). us-gaap:BasisOfAccountingPolicyPolicyTextBlock and us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock are single policy paragraphs, which none of the readings took as the critical-accounting-estimates note; us-gaap:RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationsTextBlock ('Total future commitments as of June 27, 2026 were as follows') is the purchase-commitments schedule inside the commitments note, not a contingency, as the readings that met srt:ContractualObligationFiscalYearMaturityScheduleTableTextBlock took a contractual-obligations schedule as none of the six; and us-gaap:FairValueDisclosuresTextBlock, us-gaap:SummaryOfInvestmentHoldingsScheduleOfInvestmentsTableTextBlock and us-gaap:InvestmentsClassifiedByContractualMaturityDateTableTextBlock ('The contractual maturities of available-for-sale debt securities') are the securities the company holds, not what it owes. Both quarters tag the same 32 names
